high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring two characters from Disney's "Beauty and the Beast." The setting appears to be an indoor room with a warm, orange-toned background and decorative green wallpaper with floral patterns. On the left side of the image, there is Belle, the protagonist, sitting at a table. She has red hair tied back and is wearing a pink dress. She is holding a book and looking at it with a content expression. Above her head, there is text that reads, "I just finished this book." On the right side of the image, there is the Beast, the antagonist, lying on the floor with his head
